dedupe_keys.name: uae nsdi feature catalogue 286 national feature classes for utilities transport and other themes fgic

description: The UAE NSDI Feature Catalogue, published by the Federal Geographic Information Center (FGIC) on its national geoportal, defines the feature classes that the national spatial data infrastructure of the United Arab Emirates uses to exchange geographic data. Contents: 286 feature classes, each with a code, a definition, a topic category and keywords; 53 fall under utilities and communication (for example electrical transmission overhead lines, structures and stations, distribution transformers and underground main lines, gas and oil main pipelines, gas wells and facilities, water desalination plants, water transmission lines, valves, tanks and pumping stations, sewerage main pipelines, pumping stations and treatment plants, storm water mains and pump stations, telecommunication towers, main cables and coverage), 51 under transportation (road links, nodes, centre lines, lanes, tunnels and signs; railway lines, stations, bridges, tunnels, yards and crossings; airport complexes, air navigation aids and airplane fuelling facilities), and others under inland waters, environment, boundaries and emergency management (evacuation areas, assembly points, civil defence service areas). Coverage: national data model for the UAE; the entries were created in June 2023 and last modified in September 2023. Format and access: browsable in the portal and harvestable through an OGC Catalogue Service (CSW) that returns each class with JSON, HTML and XML metadata. Free to read; licence not stated. Caveats: this is a data model, not data: the portal exposes no geometry or download for these classes, and the bounding boxes are global placeholders. Simulation uses: a reference schema for building an interdependent infrastructure network model, digital twin or asset inventory for the Emirates. Related records: none in the catalogue yet.
